service: backend-pedidos360
frameworkVersion: '4'

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: python3.13
  region: us-east-1
  role: arn:aws:iam::362471493855:role/LabRole


custom:
  pythonRequirements:
    dockerizePip: false

functions:
  pedidos:
    handler: src.pedidos.app.handler
    events:
      - http:
          path: /pedidos
          method: ANY
      - http:
          path: /pedidos/{proxy+}
          method: ANY

  encargos:
    handler: src.encargos.app.handler
    events:
      - http:
          path: /encargos
          method: ANY
      - http:
          path: /encargos/{proxy+}
          method: ANY
